title: Limited Rescue
description:
Chaotic local multiplayerThrow your friends in the lava and be the last survivor when the rescue finally comes. 
Fast and intuitive gameplay, up to 6 players on the same screen.
Use different spells to be successfulChoose and cast devastating spells. 
More than 10 different spells already available !
Super fast learningAll you need is an analog stick and 4 buttons to turn your friends in smoking roasts. Limited Rescue is very intuitive but it takes practise to truly master the elements !Free for all or in teamsLimited Rescue already offers 3 different game modes so that you can bbq your friends alone or in teams.

The game can be played with a keyboard but we highly recommend the use of gamepads (xbox, PS4, ...) to better enjoy the experience.
Limited Rescue is "Remote Play" compatible --> Only one of you needs to buy the game and is then able to invite the whole squad to join through Steam, even remotely.
description_short: The safe area is shrinking and only one may stand ! Use a variety of spells to push your friends in the hot lava and make sure you're the one getting rescued.
